✗ No target to forward calls to
  attach needs to know where your local app listens.

  Try:
    tsrelay attach stripe --to 3000
    tsrelay attach stripe --to http://localhost:8080

✗ The relay refused
  Your grants don't allow this. The relay says: Your grants no longer cover channel "prod".

  Try:
    Ask a relay admin to grant you the role or channel; the relay's web UI shows them the grant

✗ Can't reach the relay
  Tried https://tsrelay.example.ts.net (from --relay): connection refused.

  Try:
    tailscale status
    Check that the relay is running
    tsrelay hooks list --relay https://tsrelay.<your tailnet>.ts.net

✗ No hook "nope"
